research.facts:
Scheffler 2026 Season Analysis
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Scheffler has 1 win in 2026 — American Express in January (from prior pipeline notes, PGA Tour confirmed)
- Scheffler has 5 runner-up finishes in 2026 (PGA Tour confirmed as of July 26 per prior pipeline notes)
- Scheffler is 0-for-4 in 2026 majors: Masters (McIlroy won), US Open (Shinnecock), The Open Championship (Birkdale, T4 with Fleetwood), PGA Championship (Aronimink) (from prior pipeline notes)
- Scheffler missed the cut at the Scottish Open — first missed cut in over 4 years (prior pipeline notes)
- Scheffler skipped Rocket Classic (from prior pipeline notes)
- Scheffler remains World No. 1 and FedExCup No. 1 (multiple confirmed sources)
- Scheffler quote: "I think I've been really close to winning some tournaments, and that can be frustrating" (prior pipeline notes from July 27)
- Only Scheffler and Cameron Young (2022) had 5+ runner-ups in the past 40 years on Tour (prior pipeline notes, PGA Tour confirmed)
- FedExCup Playoffs start August 13 (St. Jude Championship)
